text.tspan: – next-frame pixels per token, and a lag skip

g.text: module: zpred(p) from lags [0, 2, 2] → Dec → the NEXT frame's real pixels, patch for patch
half S – the pixels, per token
z_pred(p) decoded onto the NEXT frame's patch p
patch p → the same patch, one step later
slot k reads zt−dk : [0, 2, 2] instead of [0, 1, 2]
zt−1 is dropped – the freed slot goes to zt−2
the JOINT arm – ST3 is exactly the two halves at once
the 2 flags that VARY across the three rows; the other 4 decoder flags are identical wherever they appear
checked here: the two ARMS[ ] lines must differ in exactly one flag, at the same feature
the precedent – patchdecode vs its detach control +0.140 [−0.047, +0.327] · n = 8 · NULL
a win with no ablation is uninterpretable – which is why both halves run on their own
the pixel target is the DATASET, so it cannot be gamed by degrading it
either half can be charged for the result, because both of them run
the skip is DDP-safe: 0 params with grad-is-None, the same as 0 for the uniform set
